reviews.quote: The Yoga 7a 2-in-1 hits a sweet spot for those in the market for a big touchscreen OLED two-in-one. Where it stumbles is graphics horsepower.
The Yoga 7a 2-in-1 16 checks a fair bit of the right boxes.

professional.notes: Line-level scores from the Yoga 7a 2-in-1 16 review round (aggregated by Notebookcheck); no review of this exact config as of 2026-11.

praises: $1,149 sale for a Copilot+ convertible with 1TB is the outright price/performance hero of the whole line
Ryzen AI 5 430's ~50 TOPS NPU beats Intel's Ultra 5 tier in NPU throughput at the lowest price
Quiet, cool, and adequate for office/streaming per the 512GB twin's 4.53★ owner base
1TB SSD removes the storage complaint level of the base AMD tier
Aluminium convertible build well above its sale price
complaints: Weakest GPU in the family (Radeon 840M) — not a gaming machine
Dim WUXGA IPS panel; no OLED option at this tier

design_philosophy: The AMD entry tier with the storage bump, and the line's clearance-style hero: 50%-off pricing makes a 1TB Copilot+ convertible cheaper than most budget clamshells. Everything about it is 'best value', not 'best' — panel and GPU are the cost centers.
